entities.name: 2021 South Supreme Airlines Let L-410 Turbolet crash

entities.summary: On 2 March 2021, a Let L-410 Turbolet of South Sudan Supreme Airlines crashed in Pieri, Uror County, South Sudan on a domestic flight to Yuai Airstrip, South Sudan.
